title: HTML Artifacts vs Markdown Output
summary: Use Markdown or JSON as canonical source and HTML as the human-facing view when output gets long, visual, or interactive.

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.body: Adopt a hybrid workflow: source in Markdown or JSON, rendered artifact in self-contained HTML.

sections.title: Why HTML Helps
items: Long reports become easier to scan.
Tables, timelines, callouts, and SVG diagrams preserve structure.
Throwaway editors let humans manipulate state and export it back.

cards.title: Noisy diffs
cards.body: HTML should not become the only canonical source for durable specifications.

cards.title: Token cost
cards.body: Generate HTML only when it materially improves human review.
